title: Farewells
label: ch:farewells
canDo: I can end a Sanskrit conversation politely and choose a farewell that fits the situation.

payoff.summary: Complete SA-C04-practice, the canonical closing checkpoint, and demonstrate the chapter promise: end a Sanskrit conversation politely and choose a farewell that fits the situation; then unpack punar-darśanāya and śvaḥ, and pick out र and प.
payoff.note: SA-C04-practice assesses all thirteen atoms the chapter introduces: the farewells, the roots of gam, punar-, darśana and śvaḥ, the dative of purpose, Sanskrit's one-word-one-day precision, and र and प (reached through SA-S113-letter-pa, sequence 241).
